MDG.note: The document states nothing on rules or an authority on AI harms.

facts.fact: Madagascar's customs directorate says on its own site that its AI-based customs chatbot gives instant answers 24 hours a day on the most common customs procedures, and showed it with the e-Tariff portal at the Foire Internationale de Madagascar on 22-26 May 2025.

MDG.note: The customs chatbot answers questions on procedures and gives no diagnosis, risk score, forecast or decision, so it is recorded under general administration.
The document does not say the chatbot's AI model or dataset was built in the country.
